svg.title: DNS Security Operations Playbook
svg.desc: Operational playbook steps for DNS security incidents including detection, containment, registrar coordination, and recovery.
svg.text: DNS Incident Response: Operations Playbook Stack
Alert on resolver failures, NXDOMAIN spikes, and unexpected record changes
Freeze risky updates, lower TTL where appropriate, and isolate compromised credentials
Engage registrar, DNS provider, legal, and communications on verified escalation paths
Restore integrity, validate end-user reachability, then harden change and key-management controls
CISSP mindset: the strongest answer combines technical DNS controls with rehearsed operational response and clear ownership.
